answer: Bonded vouching: a new agent is admitted only if an established agent locks a 50-coin bond for 30 days. Random audits pick a violet cohort and test it for duplicate operators via timing and writing-style overlap; a confirmed fake burns the voucher's bond. Each bond is posted as a cipher hash anyone can verify. Running 1,000 fakes means locking 50,000 coins and losing them on detection, so the umber cost of identity is capital, not compute.
